description:
This protocol is an updated version of a drug dilution protocol designed with Protocol Designer.

In this protocol, the p300-multi channel pipette (GEN1) is used to transfer 100µL media to all of the columns of the three dilution plates (10uM, 1uM, and 0.1uM). When transferring the media, the same tips (column 1) will be used for all transfers, but after every four transfers, the pipette will return the tips to the tiprack and pick up them up again to ensure a good seal with the tips.
After the media is added, the p10-multi channel pipette is used for the dilutions, transferring 10µL from a stock plate in slot 10, to the first dilution plate and so on... (using the same set of tip for each column of dilutions).
Finally, the p300-multi will be used again, this time transferring 100µL from the reservoir in slot 11 to the three dilution plates. These transfers will follow the same pattern for tip usage as the earlier transfer with the p300-multi, but instead use the tips from column 2.



To purchase tips, reagents, or pipettes, please visit our online store or contact our sales team at info@opentrons.com

P300 Multi-Channel Pipette (GEN1)
P10 Multi-Channel Pipette
Opentrons 300µl Pipette Tips
Opentrons 10µL Pipette Tips
Axygen 1-Well Reservoir, 90mL
Corning 96-Well Plate, 360µL Flat



Deck Layout

Slot 1: Corning 96-Well Plate (Drug Dilution 0.1µM)

Slot 2: Opentrons 300µl Pipette tips

Slot 4: Corning 96-Well Plate (Drug Dilution 1µM)

Slot 5: Opentrons 10µL Pipette Tips

Slot 7: Corning 96-Well Plate (Drug Dilution 10µM)

Slot 8: Axygen 1-Well Reservoir (containing Media for 1st transfer)

Slot 10: Corning 96-Well Plate (Drug Stock)

Slot 11: Axygen 1-Well Reservoir (containing Cells for 2nd transfer)
